features.name: Bestiary profiles and templates
features.reason: 20 reusable profiles and 1 supported templates. Named campaign characters are excluded. Printed entries requiring conversion remain documented for manual review.

features.name: Chaos Spawn
features.reason: Selectable on Mutant or Gor with the four printed Traits. Roll 2d10 for mutations and resolve the Tzeentch table results manually.

features.name: Transformation of the Beast (Gor form)
features.reason: Printed package needs an explicit compatibility decision, equipment/attack handling, or foundation eligibility before it can be applied automatically.
